title: Chocolate Land - Realm of the Cocoa Volcano
lore: Long ago a falling star of pure cocoa struck the Sugar Plains. Its crater became the Cocoa Volcano, which still pours molten chocolate rivers through wafer forests and gingerbread villages. Candy-cane pillars mark the old Sugar Road; hidden inside the volcano's flank is the Truffle Vault, where the first recipe is said to be kept.
notes: Secret: Truffle Vault hidden in the volcano's east flank
3 chocolate rivers + chocolate waterfall + pulsing caramel crater
